run-tests_1     |       TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP(target_date), INTERVAL 7 HOUR) AS time, 
run-tests_1     |       SUM(slot_h_diff) AS slot_h_diff_14,
run-tests_1     |       SUM(target_slot_h) AS target_slot_h_14,
run-tests_1     |       SUM(reference_slot_h) AS reference_slot_h_14
run-tests_1     |     FROM 
run-tests_1     |       `data-mesh-catalog.bigquery_analysis.bigquery_performance`
run-tests_1     |     WHERE 
run-tests_1     |       target_date='{{ macros.ds_format(ts, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z', '%Y-%m-%d') }}'
run-tests_1     |       AND comparison_days = 14
run-tests_1     |     GROUP BY 
run-tests_1     |       time
run-tests_1     |   ),
run-tests_1     | -- Joining the results to have separate columns for each comparison day
run-tests_1     | dataset_agg AS (

run-tests_1     |     (comp_day_7.target_slot_h_7 + comp_day_14.target_slot_h_14) / 2 AS mean_target_slot_h,

run-tests_1     |   FROM 
run-tests_1     |     comp_day_7
run-tests_1     |     FULL OUTER JOIN comp_day_14 ON comp_day_7.time = comp_day_14.time
run-tests_1     | ),
run-tests_1     | -- Joining the results to have separate columns for each comparison day

run-tests_1     |       slot_h_diff_14 >= mean_target_slot_h * 0.05
run-tests_1     |     THEN 'Anomaly'
run-tests_1     |     ELSE 'Normal'
run-tests_1     |   END AS anomaly_status
run-tests_1     |   FROM dataset_agg
run-tests_1     | )

run-tests_1     |   'daily' AS `window`,
run-tests_1     |   'all' AS `reservation`,
run-tests_1     |   'all' AS `project`,
run-tests_1     |   'performance_anomaly' AS `metric_name`,
run-tests_1     |   CASE
run-tests_1     |     WHEN 
run-tests_1     |       anomaly_status='Anomaly'
run-tests_1     |     THEN 1
run-tests_1     |     ELSE 0
run-tests_1     |   END AS is_anomaly

run-tests_1     | WITH
run-tests_1     | current_acp AS (
run-tests_1     | SELECT
run-tests_1     |   ghost_user_id,
run-tests_1     |   os_type,
run-tests_1     |   country,
run-tests_1     |   overall_ad_click AS current_clicks,
run-tests_1     |   overall_ad_impression AS current_impressions,
run-tests_1     |   overall_ad_click - overall_ad_lqc AS current_non_lqc,
run-tests_1     |   CASE
run-tests_1     |     WHEN overall_ad_click >= 10 AND overall_tap_ratio > 0.7 THEN 'Heavy Tapper'
run-tests_1     |     WHEN overall_ad_click >= 10 AND overall_tap_ratio < 0.3 THEN 'Heavy Swiper'
run-tests_1     |     ELSE overall_ad_click_persona
run-tests_1     |   END as current_click_persona,
run-tests_1     | 
run-tests_1     | FROM `sc-analytics.report_adsnap.ad_click_persona_{{ ds_nodash }}` acp
run-tests_1     | ),
run-tests_1     | 
run-tests_1     | month_acp AS (
run-tests_1     | SELECT
run-tests_1     |   ghost_user_id,
run-tests_1     |   overall_ad_click AS month_clicks,
run-tests_1     |   overall_ad_impression AS month_impressions,
run-tests_1     |   overall_ad_click - overall_ad_lqc AS month_non_lqc,
run-tests_1     |   CASE
run-tests_1     |     WHEN overall_ad_click >= 10 AND overall_tap_ratio > 0.7 THEN 'Heavy Tapper'
run-tests_1     |     WHEN overall_ad_click >= 10 AND overall_tap_ratio < 0.3 THEN 'Heavy Swiper'
run-tests_1     |     ELSE overall_ad_click_persona
run-tests_1     |   END as month_click_persona,
run-tests_1     | FROM `sc-analytics.report_adsnap.ad_click_persona_{{ macros.ds_add(ds,-29).replace('-','') }}` acp
run-tests_1     | ),
run-tests_1     | 
run-tests_1     | user_cohort AS (
run-tests_1     |   SELECT
run-tests_1     |     ghost_user_id,
run-tests_1     |     is_mau,
run-tests_1     |     TIMESTAMP_DIFF(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, creation_date_pst, DAY) account_age_days,
run-tests_1     | FROM `sc-analytics.report_search.user_cohorts_{{ ds_nodash }}` AS uc --SET DATE
run-tests_1     | ),
run-tests_1     | 
run-tests_1     | retentions AS (
run-tests_1     | SELECT
run-tests_1     |   ghost_user_id,
run-tests_1     |   country,
run-tests_1     |   os_type,
run-tests_1     |   COALESCE(current_clicks, 0) AS current_clicks,
run-tests_1     |   COALESCE(month_clicks, 0) AS month_clicks,
run-tests_1     |   CASE
run-tests_1     |     WHEN COALESCE(current_clicks, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(month_clicks, 0) = 0 AND account_age_days>28 THEN 'Resurrected'
run-tests_1     |     WHEN COALESCE(current_clicks, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(month_clicks, 0) > 0 THEN 'Churned'
run-tests_1     |     WHEN COALESCE(current_clicks, 0)> 0 AND COALESCE(month_clicks, 0) > 0 THEN 'Retained'
run-tests_1     |     WHEN COALESCE(current_impressions, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(month_impressions, 0) = 0 AND is_mau > 0 THEN 'Non-Ad-Viewer'
run-tests_1     |     WHEN COALESCE(current_clicks, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(month_clicks, 0) = 0 AND is_mau > 0
run-tests_1     |       AND COALESCE(current_impressions, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(month_impressions, 0) > 0 THEN 'Non-Clicker'
run-tests_1     |     ELSE 'Non-MAU'
run-tests_1     |   END AS clicker_retention,
run-tests_1     |   CASE
run-tests_1     |     WHEN COALESCE(current_non_lqc,0)>0 AND COALESCE(month_non_lqc,0)=0 THEN "Resurrected Non-LQC Clicker"
run-tests_1     |     WHEN COALESCE(current_non_lqc,0)>0 AND COALESCE(month_non_lqc,0)>0 THEN "Retained Non-LQC Clicker"
run-tests_1     |     WHEN COALESCE(current_non_lqc,0)=0 AND COALESCE(month_non_lqc,0)>0 THEN "Churned Non-LQC Clicker"
run-tests_1     |     ELSE 'No non-LQC Clicks'
run-tests_1     |   END AS non_lqc_retention,
run-tests_1     |   CASE
run-tests_1     |     WHEN month_click_persona IN ('Heavy Swiper', 'Swiper') AND current_click_persona IN ('Heavy Tapper', 'Tapper') THEN 'Swiper->Tapper'
run-tests_1     |     WHEN month_click_persona IN ('Heavy Tapper', 'Tapper') AND current_click_persona IN ('Heavy Swiper', 'Swiper') THEN 'Tapper->Swiper'
run-tests_1     |     WHEN month_click_persona IN ('Heavy Swiper', 'Swiper') AND current_click_persona IN ('Heavy Swiper', 'Swiper') THEN 'Consistent Swiper'
run-tests_1     |     WHEN month_click_persona IN ('Heavy Tapper', 'Tapper') AND current_click_persona IN ('Heavy Tapper', 'Tapper') THEN 'Consistent Tapper'
run-tests_1     |     ELSE 'No Gesture Shift'
run-tests_1     |   END AS compact_gesture_shifts,
run-tests_1     |   CONCAT(month_click_persona, '->', current_click_persona) AS full_gesture_shifts,
run-tests_1     | FROM current_acp
run-tests_1     | LEFT JOIN user_cohort USING(ghost_user_id)
run-tests_1     | FULL OUTER JOIN month_acp USING(ghost_user_id)
run-tests_1     | )
run-tests_1     | 
run-tests_1     | SELECT
run-tests_1     |   country,
run-tests_1     |   os_type,
run-tests_1     |   clicker_retention,
run-tests_1     |   non_lqc_retention,
run-tests_1     |   compact_gesture_shifts,
run-tests_1     |   full_gesture_shifts,
run-tests_1     |   HLL_COUNT.INIT(ghost_user_id, 19) AS hll_num_users
run-tests_1     | FROM retentions
run-tests_1     | GROUP BY ALL

run-tests_1     | SELECT
run-tests_1     |   user_name,
run-tests_1     |   user_id,
run-tests_1     |   last_country,
run-tests_1     |   cf_score,
run-tests_1     |   FORMAT("https://storyteller.sc-corp.net/creator?story_type=SINGLE_SNAP&user_id=%s", user_id) AS st_link,
run-tests_1     |   post_count,
run-tests_1     |   camera_roll_ratio,
run-tests_1     |   duplicate_cnt,
run-tests_1     |   num_reports,
run-tests_1     |   num_story_views,

run-tests_1     |     ( camera_roll_ratio + LEAST(4*duplicate_cnt, 5) + LEAST(num_reports/2, 1) + LEAST(6*SAFE_DIVIDE(1, creation_days_bucket), 1.5) ) AS cf_score,
run-tests_1     |     *

run-tests_1     |       COUNTIF(REGEXP_CONTAINS(a.media_source, r'SOURCE_CAMERA_ROLL')
run-tests_1     |         OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(a.media_source, r'SOURCE_MEMORIES'))/COUNT(*) AS camera_roll_ratio,
run-tests_1     |       COUNT(DISTINCT (
run-tests_1     |         IF
run-tests_1     |           (is_duplicate_from_cross_creator IS TRUE, composite_story_id, NULL))) AS duplicate_cnt,
run-tests_1     |       IFNULL(SUM(num_report_inappropriate), 0) AS num_reports,
run-tests_1     |       IFNULL(SUM(num_story_views), 0) AS num_story_views,
run-tests_1     |       MAX(last_country) AS last_country,
run-tests_1     |       IFNULL(MAX(creation_days_bucket), 600) AS creation_days_bucket,
run-tests_1     |       MAX(post_count) AS post_count,
run-tests_1     |       MAX(spotlight_creator_originality__total_repost_ratio) AS total_repost_ratio,
run-tests_1     |       MAX(spotlight_creator_originality__total_repost_exclude_logo_ratio) AS total_repost_exclude_logo_ratio,
run-tests_1     |     FROM
run-tests_1     |       spotlight_submissions a
run-tests_1     |     LEFT JOIN
run-tests_1     |       spotlight_engagement b
run-tests_1     |     ON
run-tests_1     |       a.composite_story_id =
run-tests_1     |     IF
run-tests_1     |       (CHAR_LENGTH(b.story_id) != 32, TO_HEX(MD5(b.story_id)), b.story_id)
run-tests_1     |     LEFT JOIN
run-tests_1     |       user_ids c
run-tests_1     |     ON
run-tests_1     |       a.ghost_user_id = c.ghost_id
run-tests_1     |     LEFT JOIN
run-tests_1     |       user_attributes d
run-tests_1     |     ON
run-tests_1     |       c.user_name = d.username
run-tests_1     |     JOIN
run-tests_1     |       post_history e
run-tests_1     |     ON
run-tests_1     |       a.ghost_user_id = e.ghost_user_id
run-tests_1     |     LEFT JOIN
run-tests_1     |       creator_profile f
run-tests_1     |     ON
run-tests_1     |       c.user_id = f.creator_user_id
run-tests_1     |     GROUP BY
run-tests_1     |       ghost_user_id) )

run-tests_1     | INFO  [airflow.hooks.base] Using connection ID 'google_cloud_default' for task execution.
run-tests_1     | INFO  [airflow.hooks.base] Using connection ID 'google_cloud_default' for task execution.
run-tests_1     | WITH
run-tests_1     | current_acp AS (
run-tests_1     | SELECT
run-tests_1     |   ghost_user_id,
run-tests_1     |   os_type,
run-tests_1     |   country,
run-tests_1     |   overall_ad_click AS current_clicks,
run-tests_1     |   overall_ad_impression AS current_impressions,
run-tests_1     |   overall_ad_click - overall_ad_lqc AS current_non_lqc,
run-tests_1     |   CASE
run-tests_1     |     WHEN overall_ad_click >= 10 AND overall_tap_ratio > 0.7 THEN 'Heavy Tapper'
run-tests_1     |     WHEN overall_ad_click >= 10 AND overall_tap_ratio < 0.3 THEN 'Heavy Swiper'
run-tests_1     |     ELSE overall_ad_click_persona
run-tests_1     |   END as current_click_persona,
run-tests_1     | 
run-tests_1     | FROM `sc-analytics.report_adsnap.ad_click_persona_{{ ds_nodash }}` acp
run-tests_1     | ),
run-tests_1     | 
run-tests_1     | month_acp AS (
run-tests_1     | SELECT
run-tests_1     |   ghost_user_id,
run-tests_1     |   overall_ad_click AS month_clicks,
run-tests_1     |   overall_ad_impression AS month_impressions,
run-tests_1     |   overall_ad_click - overall_ad_lqc AS month_non_lqc,
run-tests_1     |   CASE
run-tests_1     |     WHEN overall_ad_click >= 10 AND overall_tap_ratio > 0.7 THEN 'Heavy Tapper'
run-tests_1     |     WHEN overall_ad_click >= 10 AND overall_tap_ratio < 0.3 THEN 'Heavy Swiper'
run-tests_1     |     ELSE overall_ad_click_persona
run-tests_1     |   END as month_click_persona,
run-tests_1     | FROM `sc-analytics.report_adsnap.ad_click_persona_{{ macros.ds_add(ds,-29).replace('-','') }}` acp
run-tests_1     | ),
run-tests_1     | 
run-tests_1     | user_cohort AS (
run-tests_1     |   SELECT
run-tests_1     |     ghost_user_id,
run-tests_1     |     is_mau,
run-tests_1     |     TIMESTAMP_DIFF(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, creation_date_pst, DAY) account_age_days,
run-tests_1     | FROM `sc-analytics.report_search.user_cohorts_{{ ds_nodash }}` AS uc --SET DATE
run-tests_1     | ),
run-tests_1     | 
run-tests_1     | retentions AS (
run-tests_1     | SELECT
run-tests_1     |   ghost_user_id,
run-tests_1     |   country,
run-tests_1     |   os_type,
run-tests_1     |   COALESCE(current_clicks, 0) AS current_clicks,
run-tests_1     |   COALESCE(month_clicks, 0) AS month_clicks,
run-tests_1     |   CASE
run-tests_1     |     WHEN COALESCE(current_clicks, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(month_clicks, 0) = 0 AND account_age_days>28 THEN 'Resurrected'
run-tests_1     |     WHEN COALESCE(current_clicks, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(month_clicks, 0) > 0 THEN 'Churned'
run-tests_1     |     WHEN COALESCE(current_clicks, 0)> 0 AND COALESCE(month_clicks, 0) > 0 THEN 'Retained'
run-tests_1     |     WHEN COALESCE(current_impressions, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(month_impressions, 0) = 0 AND is_mau > 0 THEN 'Non-Ad-Viewer'
run-tests_1     |     WHEN COALESCE(current_clicks, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(month_clicks, 0) = 0 AND is_mau > 0
run-tests_1     |       AND COALESCE(current_impressions, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(month_impressions, 0) > 0 THEN 'Non-Clicker'
run-tests_1     |     ELSE 'Non-MAU'
run-tests_1     |   END AS clicker_retention,
run-tests_1     |   CASE
run-tests_1     |     WHEN COALESCE(current_non_lqc,0)>0 AND COALESCE(month_non_lqc,0)=0 THEN "Resurrected Non-LQC Clicker"
run-tests_1     |     WHEN COALESCE(current_non_lqc,0)>0 AND COALESCE(month_non_lqc,0)>0 THEN "Retained Non-LQC Clicker"
run-tests_1     |     WHEN COALESCE(current_non_lqc,0)=0 AND COALESCE(month_non_lqc,0)>0 THEN "Churned Non-LQC Clicker"
run-tests_1     |     ELSE 'No non-LQC Clicks'
run-tests_1     |   END AS non_lqc_retention,
run-tests_1     |   CASE
run-tests_1     |     WHEN month_click_persona IN ('Heavy Swiper', 'Swiper') AND current_click_persona IN ('Heavy Tapper', 'Tapper') THEN 'Swiper->Tapper'
run-tests_1     |     WHEN month_click_persona IN ('Heavy Tapper', 'Tapper') AND current_click_persona IN ('Heavy Swiper', 'Swiper') THEN 'Tapper->Swiper'
run-tests_1     |     WHEN month_click_persona IN ('Heavy Swiper', 'Swiper') AND current_click_persona IN ('Heavy Swiper', 'Swiper') THEN 'Consistent Swiper'
run-tests_1     |     WHEN month_click_persona IN ('Heavy Tapper', 'Tapper') AND current_click_persona IN ('Heavy Tapper', 'Tapper') THEN 'Consistent Tapper'
run-tests_1     |     ELSE 'No Gesture Shift'
run-tests_1     |   END AS compact_gesture_shifts,
run-tests_1     |   CONCAT(month_click_persona, '->', current_click_persona) AS full_gesture_shifts,
run-tests_1     | FROM current_acp
run-tests_1     | LEFT JOIN user_cohort USING(ghost_user_id)
run-tests_1     | FULL OUTER JOIN month_acp USING(ghost_user_id)
run-tests_1     | )
run-tests_1     | 
run-tests_1     | SELECT
run-tests_1     |   country,
run-tests_1     |   os_type,
run-tests_1     |   clicker_retention,
run-tests_1     |   non_lqc_retention,
run-tests_1     |   compact_gesture_shifts,
run-tests_1     |   full_gesture_shifts,
run-tests_1     |   HLL_COUNT.INIT(ghost_user_id, 19) AS hll_num_users
run-tests_1     | FROM retentions
run-tests_1     | GROUP BY ALL

run-tests_1     |       THEN 1 --if paint < c2d then c2d was longer than load time and they didn't abandon

run-tests_1     |     ELSE 0
